It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Buffalo Bills carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play), while Detroit Lions owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#12 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Buffalo Bills -5.2 with a fair total of 52.4 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Buffalo Bills pass offence vs Detroit Lions pass defence, which sits +0.174 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
